scope: Dense autoregressive Transformer pretraining intuition. Loss estimates use the Hoffmann et al. 2022 fitted surface and the 6ND training-compute approximation; they are not forecasts for modern post-training or mixture-of-experts systems.
freshness_policy: Review when primary scaling-law evidence materially changes; otherwise annually because these fitted constants are historical rather than live provider data.

presets.precision_note: The explorer uses the rounded coefficients printed in the paper. Analytical optima computed from those rounded values need not reproduce every table or fitted frontier in the paper exactly.

hoffmann-2022.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
hoffmann-2022.notes: Fits L(N,D)=E+A/N^alpha+B/D^beta and reports approximately equal scaling of model size and training tokens under compute-optimal training.

kaplan-2020.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
kaplan-2020.notes: Earlier empirical scaling-law study showing power-law relationships among loss, model size, data and training compute, with a different compute-optimal allocation regime.
